texts.text: 2 Board Report on First Quarter 2016 Permanent School Fund Performance

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Tom Heiner and Scott Berard of BNY Mellon Global and Risk Solutions, presented the first quarter of 2016 Permanent School Fund performance report. Mr. Heiner began with an overview of the U.S and foreign capital markets. Mr. Heiner then reviewed the performance of the Fund for the first quarter of 2016. He stated that the PSF returned 2.14% for the fourth quarter outperforming the target benchmark by 28 basis points. The Fund ranked in the 1Oth percentile or quartile of the Mellon Universe of Public Funds than $1.0 billion for the 3-month ending March 30, 2016. top period greater
